Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from Marrow Design. Routine questions can now go to our new shared inbox; there is no need to copy personal addresses any more. A couple of visitors in our group need step-free access to the meeting room. We are travelling together by shuttle and will sign in at reception on arrival.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Oren
Marrow Design
--

We are recruiting volunteers for the community tree planting morning later in the season.
